content.summary: Three source-level formulation checks support the distinctions raised in committed Beta findings: internal costs, equality closure and the reduced cover domain. No new revision is required. These checks validate the sampled source transfers, not every computational leaf or the external H27 historical execution.

findings.statement: The current argument extracts specific universal deductions from older sources without transferring their entire size-69 models or treating relaxed equality as strict exclusion.
findings.disposition: The cited bridge notes retain the required costs and hypotheses. Their ordinary arguments and finite checks are separate evidence layers; the manuscript's source map preserves this distinction.

revisions.action: Checked that Section 2 still presents the additive source-integrity repair rather than claiming an authenticated repository or historical computation.
revisions.result: The qualification remains adequate and the wording requirement remains resolved. Neither preservation nor the mathematical import resolves the root discrepancy or establishes source-to-run provenance.

checks.scope: Beta-R4-F1/F2: preserve the internal-member cost when citing C5
checks.method: Compared Section 4.1 with internal-proof.md, C5-internal-compatibility.md and pinned upstream/D20/PROOF.md section 1.2 plus MU42/C5_PROOF.md section 1.2.
checks.observation: The source inequality is d(y)-I_y at most 15 before internal exclusion. The new incidence proof retains residual degree minus I_y with bound 10 after subtracting five cones. Only after I_y vanishes does the plain degree-15 bound follow. The extracted C5 deduction has an arbitrary-support bridge; the old source's support-23 and mu42 model is not thereby imported.

checks.scope: Beta-R6-F1: formulate degree-19 equality closure separately
checks.method: Read Ysingle-equality-proof.md and doubled-P10.md; checked the seventeen right-hand sides, the displayed P10 stabilizer and the final inclusion-exclusion count.
checks.observation: The right-hand sides total 48, giving r at most 49 because the single marked member has coefficient zero. Equality forces d(3)=16; the stabilizer preserves P10 and the marker and transports this to d(1)=16. The ordinary synchronized-tail argument gives codegree 3 and total bound 27+16+16-3=56. Section 4.2 correctly separates this H27-dependent closure from exact arithmetic replay; no cap18 cross-star substitution is needed.

checks.scope: Beta-R2-F2: reconcile the older 29-model bridge with the current 21-model claim
checks.method: Read the cover bridge, cap15 assembly and D16-P8-no-two-cover-exclusion.md; reconstructed safe shared-leaf vertices and checked every saved deletion key.
checks.observation: The earlier exclusion removes exactly eight P8-intersection-one models. Safe I7 vertices are none except H2/H6 vertex 0 and H7 vertices 5,6, yielding thirteen Q8 gluings alongside eight P8-intersection-two models. Every current model has all 121 distinct deletion keys. Section 6 and the companion map accurately describe this domain; this inspection did not recompute all cover maxima.
